action.prompt: The Postman collection or CI configuration has changed. Run the collection at postman/pokeapi.postman_collection.json with Newman (npx newman run postman/pokeapi.postman_collection.json), show me the pass/fail results, and propose fixes for any failed assertions. Postman cloud sync is optional: if a .postman.json file exists, read it for the workspace and collection IDs and mention them, but never skip the Newman run when it is absent.
